thread:
aj: Heads-up: Tideway (enterprise fintech) is evaluating a switch from CobaltAI -> Redwood. Main asks: compatibility shim, prompt parity metrics, cost delta, and vendor security questionnaire. They want a 2-week technical POC. Thoughts?
priya: 2-week POC is doable if we scope it: 1) infra + network, 2) prompt parity + semantic checks, 3) perf/cost. Recommend start with 40 canonical prompts (20 happy, 10 edge, 10 failure cases).
sam: Pricing note: CobaltAI uses per-request tiering and reserved slots. For a comparable throughput (200 req/s), we can show: hosted per-token example and a reserved pool quote. Early rough: hosted ~0.9x token cost vs Cobalt when using rwd-quant; reserved pool amortized lower for 24/7 workloads. I'll draft numbers for 5M/20M tokens/month.
claire: Security checklist from their procurement: SOC2 attestation, KMS/HSM key control, contract clause on customer data not used for training, VPC peering, egress IP allowlist, and annual pen test report. Do we have an updated vendor pack?
legalbot: Attached standard vendor pack v3.0 answers for data use, SOC2, and KMS. Note: Tideway is asking for explicit indemnity around model outputs in regulated workflows. Legal needs the specific use case details to advise.
netops: For the POC infra, we can spin a dedicated pool in us-east-1 and provide a pair of egress IPs and an OpenVPN peering config. Need their CIDR and a testing service account. ETA 48-72 hours after creds.
priya: Compatibility approach: build a tiny shim that accepts CobaltAI-style requests and translates to Redwood API. Normalize sampling params (Cobalt p->top_p map, temp mapping), synchronize tokenizers (BPE differences), and add deterministic seed for parity tests. Also include a post-normalize step to convert date/number formats to match Cobalt's behavior where needed.
aj: can someone put together a minimal curl example for their engs so they can try the shim locally? simple mappings reduce friction.
sam: posting quick example: 
``` 
# CobaltAI -> Redwood conceptual mapping
POST /v1/redwood/generate
{
  "model": "rwd-1-xf",
  "prompt": "{{user_prompt}}",
  "temperature": 0.6,
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "stop": ["\n\n"]
}
# Map: cobalt.temp -> temperature, cobalt.topK -> top_k (if present), remap stop sequences, run tokenizer diff to align max_tokens budgeting
```
claire: I'll assemble the security packet: SOC2 report summary, KMS/HSM diagram, data handling addendum, network topology, and a redacted pen test summary. Will share link by tomorrow morning.
priya: Eval plan: run prompt set through both CobaltAI and Redwood shimbed endpoint, compute semantic similarity (embedding cosine) and token delta. Acceptance thresholds: median cosine >= 0.92, max token increase <= 15%, and hallucination flagged <= 5% on labeled set. Manual triage for any samples that fall outside.
\aj: timeline proposal: Day0: network creds + egress allowlist; Day1-2: infra + shim deploy; Day3-5: import prompts & run parity evals; Day6-8: perf & cost bench; Day9: remediation + demo; Day10: handoff + contract overview. POC length target 10 business days.
netops: confirm resources: dedicated pool, 2 GPUs, staging namespace. We'll provide egress IPs and peering details once they give test CIDR.
legalbot: to draft contract amendments we need: target reserved SKU (if any), definition of acceptable output (SLA on hallucination?), and whether Tideway requires data deletion guarantees. Please collect answers.
sam: I'll prepare the pricing slides with explicit line items for hosted and reserved for the 5M/20M token scenarios and include cost sensitivity to average tokens per response.
priya: small note on deltas: expect formatting differences (quotes, whitespace), sometimes entity casing. We'll include lightweight normalization rules in the shim and document known differences for product teams.
aj: owners: netops (infra & network), priya (parity eval & shim), sam (pricing & bench), claire (security packet), legalbot (contract). I'll set a kickoff call with Tideway for Thursday 10am ET.
claire: shared initial security packet here: https://redwood.internal/secpacks/tideway-poc (internal).
aj: great. add a smoke test that replays 200 requests across categories and surface token and semantic diffs in the dashboard. we'll use that as the gating criteria for demo.
priya: I'll add a small script to produce CSV diffs and flagged samples for manual review.
aj: perfect. I'll create tasks in presales board and assign leads. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
